title: Jeff Watts
description: The final spectacular space battle from RETURN OF THE JEDI: "I've always been an admirer of Admiral Ackbar," admits Jeff Watts. "l'd follow him into battle anywhere!" After attending the Calabasis Art Institute in L.A., Watts entered the movie industry. Finding this a very fertile area in which to perfect his drafting and painting skills, he quickly found himself working on many major movie projects. Watts says he's always had a very active imagination and attributes this to such movies as STAR WARS. His influences range in diversity from Frazetta to Frans Hals and Dean Cornwall.
